lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass. eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varies source locality) with Germany and France (where it varies language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.bar: Positive topline Phase 2 results for CUE-221 in chronic spontaneous urticaria, released 2026-09-20 06:00 ET with a 2026-09-21 08:00 ET conference call: HSS7=0 at week 12 of 54%/53%/43% at 4/2/1 mg/kg vs 11% placebo and 41% omalizumab, UAS7=0 46% at 4 mg/kg vs 11% placebo and 29% omalizumab, and 60% vs 24% complete hives resolution maintained at week 28 - with no PK or IgE data released and the study run in China by a related party of the licensor. https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/20/3365072/0/en/cue-biopharma-announces-positive-topline-results-from-cue-221-phase-2-study-in-chronic-spontaneous-urticaria.html
hunter_view.positioning_check: FINRA short interest 318,420 shares at the 2026-08-31 settlement, 4.65-4.9% of float and 1.76-2.10 days to cover (https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/cue/short-interest, https://fintel.io/ss/us/cue, both read 2026-09-22); Equibles models 337,484 shares for the 2026-09-15 settlement, i.e. essentially unchanged (https://equibles.com/stocks/cue/short-interest). In absolute terms that is roughly $9m of short at the drop-day close against a session that traded ~$99.8m, so there is NO squeeze fuel here and a positive number cannot lean on one. Float is small: a 1-for-30 reverse split on 2026-04-23 took shares outstanding from ~97.7m to ~3.3m and the July 2026 PIPE added 1,418,071 shares plus 87,500 pre-funded warrants, so ~3.5m shares traded on the drop day is on the order of the entire share count turning over once. The option chain gives no directional read at all: the baseline reports status 'unusable_chain', no two-sided ATM legs, total open interest 425 contracts and a null 25-delta skew, so there is no put skew either to agree with or to argue against.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: My findings cut squarely AGAINST the two strongest free signals in the baseline - the 22.51x volume spike, whose measured next-session base rate in my brief is -2.44% with only a 38.8% rise rate, and the 15.4% 14-day ATR, which the brief names as the best free ranker there is and which says high-volatility names keep falling - while the name's OWN history of eight comparable falls is genuinely neutral (50% up rate, median -0.42%) and the option chain is unusable, so there is no skew either way; that is why the emitted +1.5 is two full points below the +3.5 my findings sum to.

findings.finding: The cause of this fall is a readout the company and the sell side both call positive: CUE-221 met its primary endpoint with a clean dose response (54%/53%/43% HSS7=0 vs 11% placebo), met the key secondary (UAS7=0 46% at 4 mg/kg vs 11%), beat the active omalizumab comparator numerically at week 12 (54% vs 41%) and by 36 points on durability at week 28 (60% vs 24%, p<0.05), with no treatment-related serious adverse events and no anaphylaxis - so nothing disclosed on 09-20/09-21 lowers the asset's expected cash flows, and the 23.7% fall is the unwind of an event premium rather than a markdown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's eight comparable falls of -16.6% or worse over three years are a coin flip on the next close: up-rate 50.0%, median -0.42%, mean -1.59%, with a +4.38% next close after the largest of them (-30.54% on 2026-04-28) and +9.03% after -18.77% on 2026-01-15. This name does not systematically follow through after a big down day.

findings.finding: The 'funding risk' the tape priced during the reversal did not arrive: EDGAR shows NO filing by Cue Biopharma after the 2026-09-21 8-K as of 2026-09-22 pre-market - no S-1, no S-3, no 424B, no item 3.02 - and the 10-Q filed 2026-08-14 states that $17.4m of cash at 2026-06-30 plus the net proceeds of the July 2026 $50m private placement funds projected operating needs for at least twelve months, so the single largest one-session tail risk for a post-pop microcap biotech is off the table for this window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer has repeatedly raised into strength - a ~$20m offering in April 2025, a $10m offering in December 2025 at $0.28 pre-split, and the $50m PIPE at $33.21 in July 2026 - so an overnight raise into a 40% pop was the specific fear, and its absence is informative rather than neutral.

findings.finding: B. Riley's Mayank Mamtani, who initiated coverage at Buy with an $83 target on Friday 2026-09-18, published on the drop day itself that the firm plans to ACCUMULATE shares into the 24% decline, calling the trial outcomes better than expected and blaming the weakness on the undisclosed PK and IgE data - a named, dated buyer standing under the stock going into the next session.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sell-side support is weak evidence in general, but this name has only just acquired coverage: the 09-18 initiation is listed among Benzinga's top five initiations for that Friday, so the marginal institutional buyer here is new and has publicly committed rather than being a legacy holder trimming.

findings.finding: The data cannot be used to register CUE-221 in Cue's own territory and the arms that generate the headline comparisons are tiny: the study was run in CHINA by Genesis Life Sciences, a related company of Ascendant Health from which Cue licensed the ex-China rights in April 2026, and the omalizumab and placebo arms are N=17 and N=18 against N=35/36/37 on drug - so the 54%-vs-41% and 60%-vs-24% cross-arm claims rest on seventeen comparator patients, and Cue must still fund and run its own Phase 2b/3 registration-enabling CSU study plus a Phase 2 in food allergy on roughly $63m of pro-forma cash.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cue's own recent large falls that were about the programme rather than the tape followed through hard: -21.18% on 2026-04-21 was followed by -13.43%, and -19.18% on 2026-08-17 by -7.02%. Two of the baseline's eight comparables did worse than -11% the next session.

findings.finding: There is a registered, motivated supply block that one session did not clear: the July 2026 private placement sold 1,418,071 shares at $33.21 plus 87,500 pre-funded warrants into a company that had only ~3.3m shares outstanding after the 1-for-30 reverse split of 2026-04-23, and an EDGAR form EFFECT dated 2026-08-20 shows a registration statement going effective a month later - so on the order of 30% of the share count is freely saleable stock in hands with a known basis, and Monday's ~3.5m shares of volume is the first day those hands have had a bid worth hitting since the run-up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's own worst comparable, -21.18% on 2026-04-21 followed by -24.63% at the next open and -13.43% at the next close, sits immediately before the reverse split and the recapitalisation, i.e. this register has followed through when it was the supply and not the news doing the work.

outside_window.finding: The complete 36-week data set including the pharmacokinetic and IgE analyses - the specific gap B. Riley names as the reason for the selloff - will be presented at an unnamed 'upcoming scientific meeting', with no date given, so it cannot resolve inside this window but is the obvious re-rating catalyst when it lands.

A Phase 2b/3 registration-enabling CSU study plus a Phase 2 in food allergy cannot be funded from ~$63m of pro-forma cash, and this issuer has raised four times since April 2025, so a follow-on equity financing is close to certain on a multi-month view - but nothing was filed as of 2026-09-22 pre-market, so it is not a risk to this session.

findings.finding: SCTX was one of 36 names in FTSE Russell's Q3-2026 quarterly IPO additions, effective at the open of the drop day itself; the index funds' buy printed into Friday's close at 11.6x normal volume, and by Monday's close the entire +10.96% five-session run-up into that trade had been given back and then some, so the dated mechanical seller has no index-driven supply left to deliver on Tuesday.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's only two comparable falls are both no-news falls in this same post-IPO regime: 2026-08-13 -11.47% then +1.77% the next close (+0.79% at the open), and 2026-08-25 -16.21% then +1.57% the next close (+5.13% at the open). Two of two up, on an n of two.

findings.finding: There is no company-specific information to price: EDGAR shows no Scribe filing since the 2026-09-02 10-Q and Q2 8-K, the company's newsroom is empty between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-22, and no drop-day analyst action is findable - the most recent rating events are the four post-quiet-period initiations of 2026-08-18 and an H.C. Wainwright Buy of 2026-08-31.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Both of this name's prior 10%+ falls (2026-08-13, 2026-08-25) also arrived with no filing and no press release on the day, and both closed higher the next session.

findings.finding: The index give-back is one leg of a larger deflation that is only about half done: the stock ran from $21.19 on 2026-08-17 to $37.25 on 2026-08-24 (+75.8%) on the underwriter initiations that followed the IPO quiet period, and at $28.05 it has retraced only 57% of that melt-up while carrying a 14-day ATR of 12.1% - the realised-volatility bucket that keeps falling.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Inside this same four-week deflation the stock has already fallen -11.47% and -16.21%, bounced about +1.6% the next session each time, and then resumed lower to a fresh low - the bounces did not end the trend, which is the reason this finding is negative and not zero.

outside_window.finding: Preliminary Phase 1 data for STX-1150, the lead PCSK9 epigenetic-silencing LDL-C asset, is guided for H1 2027 - the only binary this name has, and it is far outside this window.
